Class TileResolutionState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.TileResolutionState
public final class TileResolutionState extends Object
Resolution state for a single offer tile during Phase 2 of a round. Encapsulates the remaining slot counters (top and bottom row) and the active player, keeping this temporary state out of Game's instance fields. Game creates a TileResolutionState when it starts processing a tile and discards it when all slots have been consumed. While it exists, it represents the current player's "turn" on that tile.

    • isCurrentRowEmpty

      public boolean isCurrentRowEmpty()
      Returns true if the current row has no cards left.

      The "current" row is the top row while it still has slots; once the top is exhausted the bottom row becomes current. This mirrors the same row ordering used in Game.handlePass().
